titles.romaji: First Kiss★Monogatari: Kiss kara Hajimaru Monogatari
titles.native: ファーストKiss★物語 〜Kissからはじまる物語〜

description: Kana's having trouble studying for her college entrance exams, and the way her older boyfriend is all but ignoring her isn't helping the matter. It all changes when she meets Shogo, a new teacher at her school and a relative of her father... one that's moving into her house!
